Interface InputErrorMapper<T extends Throwable>

Type Parameters:
T - Exception to Map
All Superinterfaces:
McpErrorExceptionMapper<T>
@Internal public interface InputErrorMapper<T extends Throwable> extends McpErrorExceptionMapper<T>
Marks the built-in mappers of failures to bind or validate the arguments of a primitive. A tool reports the errors they map as tool execution errors, which the model can see and correct, while the errors of any other mapper are sent as protocol errors.
Since:
2.2.0
